CharacterCreator code adaptation provenance

Repository: https://github.com/kblood/CharacterCreator
Revision: d9d72e7628c4a7b4bfa1127627104042fe887e12
Source: web/character.js
Source permalink: https://github.com/kblood/CharacterCreator/blob/d9d72e7628c4a7b4bfa1127627104042fe887e12/web/character.js
Adapted in: src/fauna-template.ts
Adaptation: bipolar morph weights, product corrective recipes, rest-pose capture
and inverse-bind rebasing. Atlas replaces human slider definitions with a
validated animal sidecar and uses parent-local additive joint deltas. No human
mesh, texture, MPFB source code or animation clip is included in this adaptation.
